text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back after a day out, Nice
Nature
seems like she has something to
say. I decide to
ask her about it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, actually... I'm gonna head over to
the training
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I have plans or anything. I
just want
to go practice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that her mother is coming to see
her run,
Nice Nature is extra motivated.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-it's nothing like that. I just feel like
training is
all.
choice_data_list: お母さんにいいとこ見せたいしな！
お母さんにいいとこ見せたいしね！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even I get the urge to just go out and
run
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns to leave, but I stop her and
tell her that
I'll supervise her extra
training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're here to practice too,
Nature?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Something like that. I've been slacking a
little
lately.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, are you down for some
partner
running? I'm getting bored of
flying solo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Partner running, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If my trainer is okay with it, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thanks, Nature! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All righty. Go ahead and get ready. I'll
be right
behind you.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll wait for you there!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You thought I'd say no, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that there's actually a lot she
can learn
from Mayano Top Gun.
choice_data_list: そんなことない！頑張ろう！
いい練習になると思う

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Besides, with her mother coming, we
should use
whatever we can to get
ready.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. I knew you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, a little, I guess.
choice_data_list: もしかして同じこと考えてた？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe a certain trainer I know is starting
to rub
off on me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Nice Nature takes off with
Mayano
Top Gun...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And manages to finish at the exact same
time as
her running partner!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I hope so, at least.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is exceptionally
talented, so if
Nice Nature is able to
keep pace with her, I
expect she'll gain
some confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer. It's not good to put
that kind
of pressure on me, you know?
choice_data_list: 今のネイチャなら互角に競える！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I guess I do need that kind of
mindset if I
really want to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Nice Nature takes off with
Mayano
Top Gun...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And manages to finish at the exact same
time as
her running partner!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Mayano and I... tied?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No fair! Have you been practicing
without me?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You practice when I'm not
here too,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I guess you're right! That's totally
fair then! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the run! Now I know just how
fast you
are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mayano Top Gun leaves the
track.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That Mayano... She's a real cutie, and
she shines
on the track too. The exact
opposite of me,
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... I'm glad the supporting role
could have
a good showing this time
around.
choice_data_list: ネイチャも眩しかったぞ！
ネイチャも眩しかったよ！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there you go again, making a big
deal out of
everything!
choice_data_list: これならお母さんも大喜びだ！
これならお母さんも大喜びだよ！

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (But, well... I hope that's true.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(I want to show Mom that I'm doing
well... Maybe
then she won't worry as
much.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch Nice Nature gaze up at the
sky,
something about her expression
tells me she's
gained some confidence.
